issues.title: Initiative 1 — Repository and developer experience
issues.outcome: A new developer can clone the repository, run web, worker, and PostgreSQL locally, and verify the primary journey.
issues.verification: From a clean clone, run `make bootstrap && make doctor && make test && make test-e2e && make build`; attach the command logs and the named Chromium journey result proving the web app, worker, PostgreSQL, and primary receipt flow all work locally.

issues.title: Epic — Monorepo scaffold
issues.outcome: The pnpm and Turborepo workspace builds strict TypeScript applications and shared packages reproducibly.
issues.verification: From a clean clone, run `make bootstrap && make doctor && make typecheck && make build`; attach the pinned tool versions and successful Turborepo task summary for every application and shared package.

issues.title: Epic — Local development environment
issues.outcome: One documented command path starts the local application, worker, and PostgreSQL without external credentials.
issues.verification: Run `make bootstrap && make local-up`, start `make dev`, and probe the web and worker health endpoints; attach the health responses and provider configuration showing that no external credentials are required, then run `make local-down`.

issues.title: Epic — Testing foundation
issues.outcome: Unit, integration, and browser tests provide repeatable evidence for the primary journey.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach the named unit, isolated PostgreSQL integration, and Chromium journey results, including a deliberate failing assertion that proves each test layer detects a regression.

issues.title: Epic — Documentation and ADR structure
issues.outcome: Architecture, delivery, operations, product, and runbook documentation has an understandable durable home.
issues.verification: Run `git ls-files 'docs/**' | sort` and a Markdown link check; attach the output plus a navigation review showing that architecture, delivery, operations, product, ADR, and runbook documents are discoverable from their index files.

issues.title: Epic — Codex operating instructions
issues.outcome: Repository-scoped agent instructions enforce safe, issue-led, tested, and gated changes.
issues.verification: Review `AGENTS.md` against the repository operating requirements and attach one traced agent change showing the issue link, restated acceptance criteria, tests, human-gate stop, and Conventional Commit produced under those instructions.

issues.title: Epic — Repository governance
issues.outcome: GitHub templates, ownership, update policy, labels, and roadmap conventions support disciplined delivery.
issues.verification: Run `./scripts/bootstrap-github.sh --dry-run`; attach its non-mutating report and inspect `.github/` to prove issue/PR templates, CODEOWNERS, update policy, labels, milestones, and roadmap conventions are defined.

issues.title: Story — Clone-to-build workspace bootstrap
issues.outcome: A clean clone can install pinned tools and dependencies, generate the database client, and build all packages.
issues.verification: From a clean clone with no generated client or installed dependencies, run `make bootstrap && make doctor && make build`; attach the pinned versions, install log, Prisma generation result, and successful build summary.

issues.title: Story — Verify the synthetic receipt journey in Chromium
issues.outcome: A Playwright test proves signup, submission, worker extraction, human review, result, evidence capture, and deletion.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the named Playwright Chromium result and screenshots or trace proving signup, submission, worker extraction, human review, result, evidence capture, and participant deletion.

issues.title: Gate 1 — Local scaffold approval
issues.outcome: A human reviews local setup, CI-equivalent checks, tests, documentation, and secret-scan evidence before external deployment.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human reviews local setup, CI-equivalent checks, tests, documentation, and secret-scan evidence before external deployment.

issues.title: Initiative 2 — Delivery platform
issues.outcome: One immutable image moves through CI to development while production remains manual and reversible.
issues.verification: Link the green CI run that published commit-addressed web and worker image digests, then run the human-approved development deployment and rollback workflows; attach digest equality, smoke-test, rollback, and manual production-gate evidence.

issues.title: Epic — Docker build strategy
issues.outcome: Web and worker images build reproducibly, run without embedded credentials, and are tagged immutably.
issues.verification: Run `make docker-build` twice from the same commit, inspect both web and worker images for embedded secrets, and start their health checks with environment-injected credentials; attach image digests, scan output, and health responses.

issues.title: Epic — GitHub Actions CI
issues.outcome: Pull requests and main pushes run frozen install, validation, builds, audits, and security scans with least privilege.
issues.verification: Link one pull-request and one main-branch GitHub Actions run; attach job logs proving frozen install, formatting, lint, types, unit/integration/browser tests, builds, dependency/secret/container scans, and the workflow permissions audit.

issues.title: Epic — Container registry publication
issues.outcome: CI publishes commit-addressed web and worker images to GHCR with traceable metadata.
issues.verification: Run the approved main-branch publication workflow; attach the GHCR web and worker package URLs, immutable commit digests, OCI source/revision metadata, and a pull-by-digest smoke test.

issues.title: Epic — Development deployment workflow
issues.outcome: A successful main build can deploy the same immutable digest to development and record smoke-test evidence.
issues.verification: After Gate 3 approval, run the development deployment workflow for a known CI image digest; attach the deployed digest, application/worker/database smoke results, deployment record, and successful rollback to the prior digest.

issues.title: Epic — Production release workflow
issues.outcome: Production releases require an explicit manual confirmation and proven development artifact.
issues.verification: Rehearse the production release workflow without applying infrastructure; attach evidence that it accepts only a development-tested immutable digest, pauses for named human approval, records the decision, and rejects an unapproved or mutable tag.

issues.title: Epic — Rollback and migration safety
issues.outcome: Database migrations and application releases have rehearsed, exact failure and rollback procedures.
issues.verification: Against an isolated development fixture, run the forward migration, application smoke test, forced release failure, documented rollback, and post-rollback data check; attach commands, timings, preserved-data assertions, and the updated recovery runbook.

issues.title: Epic — Preview deployment spike
issues.outcome: A documented spike determines whether isolated, temporary Dokploy previews justify their cost and complexity.
issues.verification: Attach the time-boxed preview-deployment spike report with a disposable development-only experiment, teardown proof, measured setup/idle cost, isolation risks, alternatives, and an explicit adopt-or-reject decision.

issues.title: Task — Establish least-privilege CI baseline
issues.outcome: The repository validates formatting, lint, types, tests, build, dependencies, secrets, and containers on GitHub-hosted runners.
issues.verification: Link the least-privilege GitHub Actions run and attach its permissions declaration plus successful formatting, lint, type, unit/integration/browser, build, dependency, secret, image-build, and image-scan steps.

issues.title: Initiative 3 — Hetzner infrastructure
issues.outcome: Isolated development and production environments can be recreated from reviewed, parameterized definitions.
issues.verification: Run `make infra-plan ENV=development` and `make infra-plan ENV=production` without apply; attach both saved plans, variable and state separation evidence, cost estimates, policy checks, and a reviewed environment-difference table.

issues.title: Epic — OpenTofu Hetzner modules
issues.outcome: Reusable modules describe servers, networks, SSH keys, firewalls, labels, and backup configuration without hardcoded environment data.
issues.verification: Run OpenTofu format, validate, module tests, and `make infra-plan ENV=development` without apply; attach the plan and assertions covering servers, networks, SSH keys, firewalls, labels, backups, and absence of hardcoded environment values.

issues.title: Epic — Development environment
issues.outcome: A complete reviewed OpenTofu development plan shows resources, rules, recurring cost, and recovery impact before apply.
issues.verification: Run `make infra-plan ENV=development` without apply; attach the complete saved OpenTofu plan, policy output, recurring-cost estimate, firewall summary, backup/recovery impact, and human review decision.

issues.title: Epic — Production environment
issues.outcome: Production is represented independently and remains unapplied until restore, rollback, security, and ownership evidence passes.
issues.verification: Run `make infra-plan ENV=production` without apply; attach the independently addressed state/variables, complete plan, cost and security review, plus proof that apply remains blocked until Gate 5 restore, rollback, and ownership evidence is approved.

issues.title: Epic — Firewall policy
issues.outcome: Cloud and host firewall policies are deny-by-default, minimal, reviewed, and documented.
issues.verification: Run `make infra-plan ENV=development` and the firewall policy tests without apply; attach assertions that deny unspecified ingress, enumerate every allowed port/source, compare cloud and host rules, and document the approved exceptions.

issues.title: Epic — Ansible host configuration
issues.outcome: Idempotent roles configure access, updates, Docker, time, logging, backups, and host health safely.
issues.verification: Run `ansible-playbook --check --diff` against the development inventory, then after Gate 2 approval apply it twice; attach the second zero-change result and host assertions for access, updates, Docker, time, logging, backups, and health.

issues.title: Epic — Dokploy installation
issues.outcome: Dokploy installation is automated, versioned, and validated in development before any production use.
issues.verification: After Gate 2 approval, run the pinned Dokploy installation role in development twice; attach the zero-change second run, installed version, authenticated health check, upgrade/rollback rehearsal, and proof no production host was targeted.

issues.title: Epic — Backup and restore automation
issues.outcome: Encrypted backups are observable and a development restore is proven from an isolated target.
issues.verification: Create an encrypted development backup, verify its scheduled-job alerting and checksum, restore it into an isolated target, and run data-integrity smoke tests; attach the recovery time, recovery point, key-separation, and cleanup evidence.

issues.title: Epic — Infrastructure runbooks
issues.outcome: Operators have exact provisioning, recovery, rotation, destruction, and incident procedures.
issues.verification: Run a tabletop using the infrastructure runbooks; attach the exact commands and observed results for plan, approved provision, backup/restore, credential rotation, rollback, destruction preview, and incident escalation, with every unsafe action still human-gated.

issues.title: Gate 0 — Architecture approval
issues.outcome: A human approves architecture, recurring cost, security, data flows, and initial provider choices before provisioning.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human approves architecture, recurring cost, security, data flows, and initial provider choices before provisioning.

issues.title: Gate 2 — Development infrastructure approval
issues.outcome: A human reviews the full plan, resources, cost, firewall rules, and recovery implications before tofu apply.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human reviews the full plan, resources, cost, firewall rules, and recovery implications before tofu apply.

issues.title: Gate 5 — Production infrastructure approval
issues.outcome: A human approves restore, monitoring, rollback, security, and ownership evidence before production provisioning.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human approves restore, monitoring, rollback, security, and ownership evidence before production provisioning.

issues.title: Initiative 4 — SaaS foundation
issues.outcome: Users can authenticate and reach measurable value through observable, privacy-aware platform capabilities.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named authentication, ownership, provider-failure, background-job, analytics, administration, and deletion cases plus the browser journey showing a user reaches measurable value without privacy leakage.

issues.title: Epic — Authentication
issues.outcome: Users register, sign in, sign out, recover access, and use secure sessions through the AuthProvider boundary.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e` and the secret scan; attach named browser cases for registration, sign-in, sign-out, recovery, and session expiry plus unit assertions for token hashing, cookie controls, authorization, and the AuthProvider boundary.

issues.title: Epic — User and organization data model
issues.outcome: The domain supports users and organizations with explicit ownership, roles, and deletion semantics.
issues.verification: Run `make test`; attach the named PostgreSQL integration cases for user/organization creation, role authorization, cross-organization denial, uniqueness, and cascading deletion, including schema and migration evidence.

issues.title: Epic — Transactional email
issues.outcome: Development-safe transactional messages use the EmailProvider boundary and expose delivery failures without leaking content.
issues.verification: Run `make test`; attach named EmailProvider contract cases for development capture, successful delivery, retryable/permanent failure, idempotency, and structured logs that exclude recipient and message content.

issues.title: Epic — Product analytics
issues.outcome: Reviewed activation events can be queried without sending sensitive input or unnecessary identifiers.
issues.verification: Run `make test`; attach the event-schema/privacy unit cases, an ownership-safe analytics query result for the reviewed activation funnel, and an inspection showing raw input, email, and unnecessary identifiers are absent.

issues.title: Epic — Error monitoring
issues.outcome: Errors are visible, actionable, and scrubbed of credentials, raw documents, and unnecessary personal data.
issues.verification: Run `make test`; exercise the named failure path and attach the resulting structured log, metric, trace, or alert evidence that proves: Errors are visible, actionable, and scrubbed of credentials, raw documents, and unnecessary personal data.

issues.title: Epic — Background jobs
issues.outcome: PostgreSQL-backed work is idempotent, retryable, observable, and operable without Redis.
issues.verification: Run `make test`; attach the named PostgreSQL integration cases for idempotent enqueue, concurrent claim, retry/backoff, fenced stale-lease recovery, terminal failure, cancellation, and structured queue logs, with no Redis dependency.

issues.title: Epic — Feature flags
issues.outcome: Experiments and risky capabilities can be targeted and disabled through reviewed feature flags.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named cases proving default-off behavior, allowed audience targeting, unauthorized denial, kill-switch effect without restart, and an auditable flag-change record.

issues.title: Epic — Administrative operations
issues.outcome: Privileged operations are authorized, audited, rate-limited, and deliberately narrow.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named denial/allow cases for each privileged operation, audit-event assertions, spoof-resistant rate-limit coverage, and proof that the administrative interface exposes no broader mutation.

issues.title: Epic — Data export and deletion
issues.outcome: A user can obtain or delete their data through observable, tested, and authorization-safe operations.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named ownership and concurrency cases proving a user can export only their data and deletion removes sessions, submissions, linked queue jobs, results, consents, payments, and analytics without orphans.

issues.title: Gate 3 — Development release approval
issues.outcome: A human approves authentication, consent, analytics, error handling, and deletion before external users are invited.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human approves authentication, consent, analytics, error handling, and deletion before external users are invited.

issues.title: Initiative 5 — Product experiment framework
issues.outcome: A hypothesis can be launched, manually fulfilled, measured, and decided from observed evidence.
issues.verification: Attach a dated evidence table with source links, sample size, pass/fail threshold, counter-evidence, and the decision showing whether the observations prove: A hypothesis can be launched, manually fulfilled, measured, and decided from observed evidence.

issues.title: Epic — Product hypothesis schema
issues.outcome: Every experiment starts from a falsifiable segment, pain, outcome, activation, and payment hypothesis.
issues.verification: Run the hypothesis-schema unit tests and validate a representative experiment record; attach field-level failures for missing segment, pain, outcome, activation, threshold, payment, owner, and review date.

issues.title: Epic — Landing-page template
issues.outcome: A reusable accessible template can present a hypothesis and capture one measurable primary action.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the named browser test plus screenshots at 390×844 and 1440×900 that prove: A reusable accessible template can present a hypothesis and capture one measurable primary action.

issues.title: Epic — Waitlist and interview recruitment
issues.outcome: Consenting participants can join a waitlist and opt into interviews with minimal data collection.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the named waitlist/interview opt-in journey, consent-version assertion, minimal stored-field inspection, withdrawal/deletion case, and responsive screenshots.

issues.title: Epic — Experiment event taxonomy
issues.outcome: Acquisition, activation, fulfilment, retention, and payment events have stable reviewed meanings.
issues.verification: Run the event-taxonomy schema tests; attach the versioned event dictionary, required/forbidden property assertions, and one query fixture showing acquisition, activation, fulfilment, retention, and payment events retain stable meanings.

issues.title: Epic — Human-assisted fulfilment queue
issues.outcome: Authorized humans can fulfil experiment work and record effort, corrections, and completion safely.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach the named unit or PostgreSQL integration case and its assertions that prove: Authorized humans can fulfil experiment work and record effort, corrections, and completion safely.

issues.title: Epic — Evidence dashboard
issues.outcome: Decision-makers can compare delivery, behavior, qualitative evidence, accuracy, effort, and payment signals.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the named browser test plus screenshots at 390×844 and 1440×900 that prove: Decision-makers can compare delivery, behavior, qualitative evidence, accuracy, effort, and payment signals.

issues.title: Epic — Experiment decision record
issues.outcome: Continue, Iterate, Pause, Reject, or Scale decisions cite supporting and counter evidence.
issues.verification: Run the experiment-decision schema tests and validate one completed decision record; attach assertions requiring a valid decision enum, supporting evidence, counter-evidence, limitations, owner, and decision date.

issues.title: Epic — Kill, iterate, or scale workflow
issues.outcome: A reviewed experiment decision produces an explicit stop, revision, pause, rejection, or scale action.
issues.verification: Run the decision-workflow unit and browser tests; attach named transition cases proving each Continue, Iterate, Pause, Reject, and Scale decision creates its required follow-up action and blocks unreviewed transitions.

issues.title: Gate 4 — Product evidence review
issues.outcome: A human reviews external completion, manual effort, accuracy, user language, and payment intent before automation.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human reviews external completion, manual effort, accuracy, user language, and payment intent before automation.

issues.title: Initiative 6 — First vertical slice
issues.outcome: At least five external users complete the receipt journey and produce measured effort, accuracy, feedback, and payment evidence.
issues.verification: Run the full receipt browser journey, then attach a dated de-identified evidence table for at least five consenting external users with completion, manual effort, field accuracy, interview feedback, price response, thresholds, counter-evidence, and the Gate 4 decision.

issues.title: Epic — Experiment definition
issues.outcome: The receipt experiment has a target segment, thresholds, stop conditions, method, and evidence plan.
issues.verification: Review the versioned receipt experiment record before recruitment; attach field-level evidence for target segment, method, sample, completion/accuracy/effort/payment thresholds, stop conditions, dates, owner, and planned evidence sources.

issues.title: Epic — Consent and privacy copy
issues.outcome: Participants understand the data, purpose, human access, retention, deletion, and experiment limitations before submission.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the consent-gating browser case and mobile/desktop screenshots, plus a privacy review confirming the copy states collected data, purpose, human access, retention, deletion, synthetic-only input, and experiment limitations before submission.

issues.title: Epic — Receipt intake
issues.outcome: Consenting users can submit the approved receipt format through a validated, rate-limited, ownership-safe path.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach the named unit or PostgreSQL integration case and its assertions that prove: Consenting users can submit the approved receipt format through a validated, rate-limited, ownership-safe path.

issues.title: Epic — Structured extraction
issues.outcome: The extraction boundary produces evaluated fields and keeps model output separate from human-corrected truth.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach the named extraction contract/integration cases with fixed fixtures, field-level expected-versus-actual assertions, invalid-output handling, and proof extracted values remain separate from human corrections.

issues.title: Epic — Human verification
issues.outcome: An authorized human can compare source and extraction, correct fields, and record time and changes.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named authorization, source/extraction comparison, field-correction, completion-time, change-record, and concurrent-deletion cases from the reviewer journey.

issues.title: Epic — User result
issues.outcome: The submitting user alone can view a clear structured result and its human-verification status.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the named browser test plus screenshots at 390×844 and 1440×900 that prove: The submitting user alone can view a clear structured result and its human-verification status.

issues.title: Epic — Activation measurement
issues.outcome: The full funnel from landing view through result and payment response is measurable with reviewed events.
issues.verification: Run the analytics schema/ownership tests and full browser journey; attach the funnel query and event counts from landing, signup, submission, extraction, review, result, and payment response, with duplicate and sensitive-property checks.

issues.title: Epic — Interview and feedback loop
issues.outcome: Participant interviews capture their language, workaround, perceived value, doubts, and requested outcome.
issues.verification: Attach at least five consented, de-identified interview records using the approved guide, with attributed language for workaround, perceived value, doubts, and requested outcome plus a synthesis that preserves counter-evidence.

issues.title: Epic — Pricing test
issues.outcome: Users see a concrete price and provide an interpretable payment or commitment signal without live charging.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e`; attach the named price-display and response-capture case, proof no charge/provider call occurs, and a dated aggregate of interested/unsure/not-interested responses by the predeclared threshold.

issues.title: Story — Define receipt experiment thresholds
issues.outcome: The first external test has explicit completion, accuracy, effort, interview, and payment thresholds before recruitment.
issues.verification: Attach the versioned experiment definition committed before the first recruitment timestamp, with numeric completion, field-accuracy, manual-effort, interview, and payment thresholds plus explicit stop/iterate rules and owner approval.

issues.title: Initiative 7 — Monetisation
issues.outcome: An evidence-backed test customer can complete safe test-mode billing while live mode remains human-gated.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e` with isolated Stripe test credentials; attach the priced checkout, signed webhook, entitlement, portal, failure, refund, cancellation, and revenue-event cases plus proof live credentials and live release remain blocked by Gate 6.

issues.title: Epic — Pricing hypothesis
issues.outcome: Price, unit, segment, expected behavior, and falsification threshold are documented from observed evidence.
issues.verification: Attach the versioned pricing hypothesis with source evidence, target segment, price and billing unit, expected behavior, sample, numeric falsification threshold, counter-evidence, owner, and review date recorded before the test.

issues.title: Epic — Stripe test-mode integration
issues.outcome: Stripe test mode implements the BillingProvider boundary with isolated credentials and no live capability.
issues.verification: Run the BillingProvider contract/integration tests with isolated Stripe test credentials; attach test-mode account evidence, idempotency and failure cases, secret scan, and a guard test proving live keys or live mode are rejected.

issues.title: Epic — Checkout
issues.outcome: A test customer can understand the offer and complete a server-created test checkout session.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e` against Stripe test mode; attach the named offer/checkout browser case, server-created session assertion, cancel/success paths, and screenshots at 390×844 and 1440×900.

issues.title: Epic — Webhook processing
issues.outcome: Signed billing webhooks are idempotent, replay-safe, observable, and processed asynchronously.
issues.verification: Run `make test`; attach named integration cases for valid/invalid signatures, duplicate and out-of-order delivery, asynchronous enqueue, atomic idempotency, retry, dead-letter visibility, and sensitive-log scrubbing.

issues.title: Epic — Entitlements
issues.outcome: Server-side billing state is the authoritative source for product entitlements.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named cases proving server-side webhook state grants/revokes entitlement, client claims cannot override it, stale events are ignored, and authorization changes are visible in the user journey.

issues.title: Epic — Billing portal
issues.outcome: A test customer can manage supported billing details and cancellation through an authenticated portal.
issues.verification: Run `make test-e2e` in Stripe test mode; attach named authenticated portal-launch, cross-user denial, supported-detail update, cancellation, and return-path cases plus screenshots at 390×844 and 1440×900.

issues.title: Epic — Failed-payment handling
issues.outcome: Failed test payments change entitlement and communication state predictably without duplicate side effects.
issues.verification: Run `make test && make test-e2e`; attach named declined-payment and failed-invoice cases proving deterministic entitlement, communication, retry, recovery, duplicate-webhook, and user-visible states.

issues.title: Epic — Refund and cancellation process
issues.outcome: Refund and cancellation behavior is tested and documented for users and operators.
issues.verification: Run the Stripe test-mode refund and cancellation integration/browser cases; attach full/partial refund, immediate/end-of-period cancellation, duplicate request, entitlement, notification, audit, support, and rollback runbook evidence.

issues.title: Epic — Revenue analytics
issues.outcome: Test revenue, conversion, cancellation, refund, and payment failure events have stable reviewed definitions.
issues.verification: Run the revenue-event schema and reconciliation tests; attach the versioned definitions and a fixture query reconciling checkout conversion, test revenue, cancellation, refund, and payment failure counts to billing records without double counting.

issues.title: Epic — Live-payment readiness review
issues.outcome: A human can evaluate pricing, legal and tax review, support, refunds, cancellation, security, and customer readiness before live mode.
issues.verification: Attach the completed live-payment readiness checklist with pricing evidence, named legal/tax/security/support owners, refund/cancellation rehearsal, incident and credential-rotation review, a ready customer, unresolved risks, and the explicit Gate 6 decision; no live-mode call is part of this verification.

issues.title: Gate 6 — Live monetisation approval
issues.outcome: A human approves pricing, legal and tax review, refund, cancellation, support, and a ready customer before Stripe live mode.
issues.verification: Attach the gate evidence report, link every cited artifact, and record the explicit human decision that proves: A human approves pricing, legal and tax review, refund, cancellation, support, and a ready customer before Stripe live mode.
